exact_quote: These instructions copy data from place to place, and from state space to state space, possibly converting it from one format to another. mov, ld, ldu, and st operate on both scalar and vector types. The isspacep instruction is provided to query whether a generic address falls within a particular state space window. The cvta instruction converts addresses between generic and const, global, local, or shared state spaces.
context_before: 14772-14775: section heading 9.7.9. Data Movement and Conversion Instructions
context_after: 14781: ld, st, suld, and sust support optional cache operations
reason_for_inclusion: Section 9.7.9 intro: data movement instructions copy data from place to place; mov, ld, ldu, and st operate on both scalar and vector types.
